shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head && echo ---- && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -B2 -A12 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue useThemeType Switch SegmentedRadioGroup Icon 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; echo ----; grep -n -C3 -E 'useTheme|useThemeValue|useThemeType|setTheme|ThemeProvider' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -120

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; ls $U/components/theme/; echo ----; cat $U/components/theme/index.d.ts $U/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts $U/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts $U/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts $U/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts $U/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>&1; echo ----; cat $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/components/Switch/index.d.ts 2>&1; cat $U/components/Switch/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat $U/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts; echo ----; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; grep -E '^export \{ default as (Sun|Moon)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rlE 'Sun|Moon' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -oE 'as (Sun|Moon)[A-Za-z]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | sort -u

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n -A12 'interface ControlProps' $U/components/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n -A6 '"dependencies"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A3 '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json; echo ----; grep -n -A4 'Segmented' $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short
